q: When do I receive payment for my orders?
a: Payments are settled after the order is delivered and the return window closes. Check the Payments section of your seller dashboard for the exact settlement date of each order.

q: Why is my payment amount lower than the order value?
a: The settlement amount is the order value minus the marketplace commission, shipping fee, and any applicable taxes or penalties. Your payment statement lists each deduction.

q: My payment is delayed. What should I do?
a: First confirm the order is marked delivered and the return window has passed. If both are true and it is still delayed, raise a ticket with the order ID and expected settlement date.

q: How do I list a new product?
a: Go to Catalogue > Add Product, choose the category, fill in title, price, images, and stock, then submit. The listing goes live after a quality check.
Common reasons are low-quality or watermarked images, wrong category, missing brand or size details, and prohibited items. The rejection reason is shown on the listing; fix it and resubmit.

q: How do I update price or stock?
a: Open Catalogue > My Products, select the product, edit price or inventory, and save. Changes usually reflect within a few minutes.

q: How do I ship an order?
a: After you confirm an order, print the shipping label and invoice from the Orders page, pack the item, and hand it to the courier partner at pickup.

q: The courier did not come for pickup.
a: Pickups can be rescheduled from the Orders page. If it is missed twice, raise a ticket with the order ID and the missed pickup date.

q: A customer returned a damaged or wrong item. What happens?
a: The returned item is inspected. If the damage or mismatch is not caused by you, you can raise a dispute with photos within the dispute window shown on the Returns page.

q: How can I reduce my return rate?
a: Use accurate titles, clear images from multiple angles, correct size charts, and honest descriptions. Reviewing return reasons in your dashboard helps spot patterns.

q: How do I update my bank details?
a: Go to Settings > Bank Details, add the new account, and verify it with the document or penny-drop check. Payments after verification go to the new account.

q: My account is blocked or restricted.
a: Restrictions usually follow policy violations, high cancellations, or pending KYC. The reason appears on your dashboard. Fix the issue and raise a ticket to request a review.

q: How can I get more orders?
a: Improve listing quality, price competitively, keep stock available, ship on time, and join marketplace sale events and promotions from the Promotions tab.
Frequent seller-side cancellations can lead to penalties. If you must cancel, do it before dispatch from the Orders page and choose the correct reason.

q: How are GST and invoices handled?
a: Add your GSTIN in Settings. An invoice is generated per order with the correct tax details, and you can download it from the Orders page.
